author: Ifmyante
text:
I see direct democracy working if it's split into a consituency system akin to the one we have now, but improved.

The decision from the votes in each area would be one vote, which has
the same weight as the one overall vote from areas larger and smaller,
thus reducing the risk of absolute majority rule.

I believe that we must be able to trust ourselves, as a race which is
now capable of understanding the balance needed to live in happy harmony
 on this planet, to make wise decisions which work for our entire
family. We've tried handing over control to our wisers and betters, and
are paying dearly for it!

You're absolutely right to withhold belief of anything I say. I'd be just the very same myself!

The whole team is gearing up to put our money where our mouth is though, so we'll see soon enough!

Yes, I'd love to buy the World and give it to the people, but I'd be far
 more happy to see the people rise up and take it for themselves

author: Ifmyante
text:
I'm way too disorganised to use limit orders!

I just open the charts from time to time, and if I see the ITs scaring
the retailers into closing good trades at a good level, I enter.

I'll take off some of the position at the first target, so if my stop
gets taken I can profit overall, then watch PA level by level. If price
doesn't get into a big zone quickly, I'll usually get bored and go flat,
 having made enough to cover my next week's expenses.

If I were truly meticulous, I'd treat my exits the same as my entries,
and trade up and down all day, but trading is usually way down on my
to-do list
